get.summary: Get current user's career, plan, file number and social handles

patch.summary: Update career, plan, social handles and/or set the file number once
patch.description: Null fields are left alone; empty string clears. `plan` must be a plan id of the resulting career (400 otherwise); changing `careerId` without `plan` clears the plan. Social fields accept a handle, @handle or profile URL and are stored as the bare handle. `fileNumber` (the ITBA legajo, 5-6 digits, 400 otherwise) can only be set while it is empty: 409 `FileNumberAlreadySet` if a different one is already stored (sending the same one is a no-op), 409 `FileNumberTaken` if another account has it. It cannot be cleared here; staff change it via PATCH /v1/users/{id}/file-number. On a 409 nothing is saved.

bearerAuth.description: CEITBA-issued HS256 JWT (never a Google token). Web SPAs receive it as the HttpOnly session cookie after GET /v1/auth/google; the mobile app gets it from POST /v1/auth/google/mobile (Google ID token exchange) and renews it with POST /v1/auth/refresh. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <jwt>.

apiKey.description: Either the static AUTH_SYNC_API_KEY for /v1/sync/** (cron / ops), or a per-user ceitba_* key created via POST /v1/auth/api-keys.
